mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.activity_id, p.award_id, p.award_count, p.award_rate, p.stock_bucket_count, CASE WHEN p.stock_bucket_count = 0 THEN p.award_surplus_count ELSE (SELECT SUM(b.remaining_count) FROM award_stock_bucket b WHERE b.activity_id = p.activity_id AND b.award_id = p.award_id) END AS award_surplus_count, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM activity_prize p WHERE p.activity_id = #{activityId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT p.activity_id, p.award_id FROM activity_prize p LEFT JOIN award_stock_bucket b ON b.activity_id = p.activity_id AND b.award_id = p.award_id WHERE p.activity_id = #{activityId} AND p.stock_bucket_count > 0 GROUP BY p.activity_id, p.award_id, p.stock_bucket_count, p.award_count HAVING COUNT(b.bucket_id) != p.stock_bucket_count OR COALESCE(MIN(b.bucket_id), -1) != 0 OR COALESCE(MAX(b.bucket_id), -1) != p.stock_bucket_count - 1 OR COALESCE(SUM(b.initial_count), 0) != p.award_count OR COALESCE(SUM(b.remaining_count), 0) > p.award_count ) invalid_layouts
SELECT stock_bucket_count FROM activity_prize WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND award_id = #{awardId}
